description: Preregistered M017 prospective synthetic qualification. Frozen before any final labels are used for inference. All comparisons paired by leakage group (row metrics) or pair id (pair metrics) with 95% percentile bootstrap CIs (seed 170018, 2000 replicates, sorted).

primary_estimands.comparison: tinymlp minus each legacy head, paired leakage-group bootstrap
primary_estimands.success: lower 95% CI bound > 0.10 for all three legacy heads (Holm-Bonferroni over 3)
primary_estimands.note: DEV observed diff +0.333; margin 0.10 requires a substantial replicated effect

negative_controls.note: must not solve choice from context alone; DEV 0.29

negative_controls.gate: conditional argmax differs across causal flips on > 50% of pairs
negative_controls.note: rejects flip-invariant models; DEV consistency low by design
informational only; contradictions are not a primary failure

operating_threshold: 0.63 from M016 DEV (frozen in artifact calibration; no final retuning)

verdicts.fixed_rule_robustness: PASS iff P1 success on fixed-rule families AND S1..S5 pass; else FAIL (or INDETERMINATE if any required family under minimum support)
verdicts.rule_conditioned_composition: PASS iff S6 passes on the exclusive track; else FAIL (or INDETERMINATE if under-supported)
verdicts.overall: synthetic-only positive iff both tracks PASS; negative if any track FAILs on powered support; indeterminate on freeze violation, missing family, leakage, or interrupted inference

forbidden: rerun on the cohort for any reason
